mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_mall_order ( order_no, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, address, pay_method, remark, points_deducted, points_amount, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{address}, #{payMethod}, #{remark}, #{pointsDeducted}, #{pointsAmount}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser} )
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_mall_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE stellar_mall_order SET pay_method = #{payMethod} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE stellar_mall_order SET status = 'SHIPPED', tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, delivery_company = #{deliveryCompany}, delivery_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAID'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stellar_mall_order WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM stellar_mall_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.pay_amount), 0) AS pay_amount, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.is_refunded = 1 THEN 1 END) AS refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_refunded = 1 THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_amount FROM stellar_mall_order o
o.create_time BETWEEN CONCAT(#{year}, '-01-01') AND CONCAT(#{year}, '-12-31 23:59:59')
AND o.status != 'CANCELLED'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC
SELECT * FROM stellar_mall_order WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND create_time < #{cutoffTime} ORDER BY id ASC
